instruction: A candid outdoor photograph, full shot at eye-level. In an outdoor grassy field with autumn trees in the background, the woman in the maroon patchwork dress (R2) on the left and the woman in the peach and blue patterned dress (R1) on the right face each other. Both are barefoot and holding hands with their arms fully extended forward in a dance pose. Warm natural daylight illuminates the scene with soft shadows.
